name: HyperINR
definition: A method predicting INR weights from scene parameters via a hypernetwork, using an ensemble of multi-resolution hash encoders organized in a KD-tree over the parameter space.
summary: HyperINR instantiates neural implicit representations by predicting network weights via a hypernetwork or KD-tree ensemble, bypassing per-volume optimization to achieve 100 times the inference bandwidth of teacher models.
